toggle.label: Sub-org invite
toggle.description: Enrolling via this invite into a sub-org-associated batch creates a sub-organization. Configure its admin roles, permissions and seat limit below.

authRoles.label: Admin roles (auth service)
authRoles.description: Roles assigned to the user who joins via this invite.

allowedTeamRoles.label: Allowed team roles
allowedTeamRoles.description: Roles the sub-org admin can assign to their own team. Leave empty to allow any custom role.

adminPermissions.label: Admin permissions
adminPermissions.description: What the sub-org admin can do. Leave empty to grant FULL access.

seatLimit.label: Seat limit
seatLimit.description: Maximum members in the sub-org. Leave blank for no explicit cap.
